Convert between units

Source: R/harmonise.R
convert_units.Rd

Converts energy, mass, money-scale and population units used by EIA and BEA. Electricity is converted to Btu at the thermal equivalent of 3,412.14 Btu per kWh (the convention used in SEDS for electricity consumption).

Usage

convert_units(x, from, to)

convert_units_available()

Arguments

x

Numeric vector.

from, to

Unit names (case-insensitive), for example "billion Btu", "MMBtu", "thousand MWh", "million metric tons", "short ton", "million dollars". See convert_units_available().

Value

Numeric vector in the to unit.

Examples

convert_units(1, "trillion Btu", "billion Btu")
#> [1] 1000
convert_units(1000, "thousand MWh", "TWh")
#> [1] 1
convert_units(1, "million metric tons", "short ton")
#> [1] 1102311
